rulesPolicy: One actual recipe-347 mining candidate instance contributes its printed +2 Mining check, distinct ordinary reserve on Critical Success, and measured preparation within the unchanged extraction schedule. Candidate and source feasibility are checked at work and resolution. Codex/GPT operational completions are separately recorded in MINING_RULE_DECISIONS.md.

Direct lead participation, qualifying active work, current physical eligibility and retained tool claim.

Recipe-347 card identity and all three printed mining effects.
Reviewed public candidate data for the printed effects and shared candidate eligibility predicates.
